videos.script: Containment stopped the damage growing. It did not remove anything. {{after}} Eradication is the removal: whatever was left behind, and the hole it came through. {{remove}} In your lab, that means an audit. Every key that can log in, checked against a list of keys somebody approved. {{audit}} Then closing the hole, so a guessed password cannot work again. Recovery is bringing things back, and the trap is simple. Rebuild from the old recipe, and you rebuild the old hole. {{rebuild}} So every fix goes into the recipe, and every return to service is checked before the next.
